description: Bounded ColorUtils mutants for validating deterministic color-distance, clustering, and nearest-center contracts.

mutants.old: return dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db;
mutants.new: return dr * dr + dg * dg - db * db;
mutants.description: Drop the blue-channel contribution from the documented squared RGB metric.
Allow a non-empty input with zero requested clusters to enter k-means instead of returning an empty result.
Reverse nearest-color selection so exact and nearby centers no longer receive their closest IDs.
